(C) the gates report CHORD length 500.62 au = 600.74 mm while the drawn Catmull-Rom path is 508.20 au = 609.8 mm (1.000-1.037 per nerve), so the published total understates the tube by 1.5%. (D) CN I has neither exit landmark nor nucleus, so its first waypoint [11,9,66] rests on nothing external - recorded, not hidden.
